|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Ben Solo]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 24 release sheet (PDF created 2 February 2025), cut unchanged from page 2. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Ben Solo]]): Players Committee card image first published 26 December 2024<ref name="ht-d64059d">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual24-Light/large/bensolo.gif</code> as published 26 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d64059dd1b272bb73e7c5e8e8f001036fd2a5524/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/bensolo.gif holotable commit d64059d] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If drawn for destiny, may take Rey or a lightsaber into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys only if an [Episode VII] Epic Event on table. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each of your Interrupts out of play (limit +3). Once per game, may deploy a lightsaber on Ben from Lost Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 2 February 2025: “If drawn for destiny, may take Rey or a lightsaber into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys only if an [Episode VII] Epic Event on table. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each of your Interrupts out of play (limit +3). Once per game, may deploy a lightsaber on Ben from Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Ben Solo]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Ben Solo]] (published 26 December 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Ben Solo”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
